programs.title: Merv Hughes Fishing
programs.sub_title: Eildon, Beaufort and the Goulburn River
programs.desc: Merv Hughes Fishing is a light hearted fishing show with some ripping catches, a few yarns (mostly true), mateship and of course a splash of comedy thrown in.

programs.title: Creek To Coast
programs.desc: Creek to Coast is all things boating, camping, 4WDing, outdoor adventuring and fishing. From bush-bashing to cooking to caravanning to watersports, Creek to Coast has it all.

programs.title: Mighty Ships
programs.desc: FPSO Maersk Peregrino is the most expensive single project in Maersk history; she is the world's biggest oil production ship and will be permanently hooked up at the Peregrino oilfield off the coast of Rio de Janeiro.

programs.title: Swamp People: Serpent Invasion
programs.desc: Troy and Pickle witness how far the pythons have spread as Zak and Aaron take on a new type of beast. Meanwhile, Bill and Tes tackle some uninvited guests.

programs.title: Australia ReDiscovered
programs.desc: Join Ricko as he heads to the Vic High Country to check out the source of an iconic poem before heading West to check out a WA ghost town then into the city to tell the tale of our only military coup.

programs.title: American Restoration
programs.desc: When a 1960s Pak Trak hunting scooter lands at the shop, Rick calls Danny 'The Count' to check out the unique dirt mobile.
